_doc: Hand-curated overrides for canonical special-case bounty posters. Standard Marine 'WANTED — Dead or Alive' posters with the cream paper + Marine HQ stamp are the default; this file lists characters whose canon poster differs in design, language, or issuing body. Add via PR with chapter citation.
_verification_needed: Cross Guild bounty design — the references currently in the codebase may be older sketch versions rather than the final canonical poster look. Re-check against the Egghead-onward chapters for proper Cross Guild aesthetic + which Marines have actually had Cross Guild bounties confirmed on-page. Update once verified.
Brook 'Soul King' poster — visual based on a stylised Whole Cake Island era reference. Confirm current canonical design after the Egghead/Elbaph chapters.
Sanji ONLY ALIVE — confirm whether his current bounty is still ONLY ALIVE post-Wano or if it reverted to standard 'Dead or Alive'.
Should the special-style flagging extend to other characters (e.g. Edward Newgate's giant battlefield bounty placard, Charlotte Linlin's Big Mom Pirates branding)?

_styles.only-alive: Standard Marine paper, but says 'ONLY ALIVE' in red instead of 'Dead or Alive'. Used when a target is wanted unharmed (Sanji during the Whole Cake Island wedding setup).
_styles.soul-king: Brook's iconic post-timeskip poster — dark theatrical background with his skull illustration instead of a photo, 'THE SOUL KING' as the title, ornate borders.
_styles.cross-guild: Cross Guild bounty (issued by Buggy/Mihawk/Crocodile) — black & red palette, 'BOUNTY' banner with crossed-bones logo. Posted on Marine targets after Wano.

Sanji.note: Wedding-period bounty issued by Big Mom's faction.

Brook.note: Post-timeskip Soul King fame poster, no photo — just his skull silhouette in top hat.

Sakazuki.note: Marines' Fleet Admiral, top Cross Guild target.

Kuzan.note: Defected to Blackbeard but still on the Cross Guild slate as a former Admiral.

Monkey D. Garp.note: Vice Admiral / Hero of the Marines — top Cross Guild target.
